description: This file defines a React functional component 'TagsListItem' used to render individual tag items within a tags list UI, supporting features like editing, selection, nesting, drag-and-drop, and context menu interactions in a tagging system.

methods.name: toggleChildren
methods.description: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of child tags.

methods.name: selectCurrentTag
methods.description: Sets the current tag as selected in the navigation controller.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Saves the edited tag title when input loses focus.

methods.name: onInput
methods.description: Updates the tag title state during editing.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events such as Enter key for committing edit.

methods.name: onSubtagInputBlur
methods.description: Creates a new subtag when input loses focus.

methods.name: onSubtagKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events during subtag creation.

methods.name: toggleContextMenu
methods.description: Opens or closes the context menu for a tag.

methods.name: onDragStart
methods.description: Initiates drag operation with tag UUID.

methods.name: onDragEnter
methods.description: Handles drag entering the target area.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles dropping a dragged tag onto this tag.
